method: Profiles project only source-proven adapter boundaries onto the frozen public nxandroid phase vocabulary. A structurally executable profile is not a claim of Android runtime validation.

public_contract.runtime_claim: The core validates boundary order only; every object and action remains adapter-owned.

java_vm.semantics: Stable adapter VM identity is established before libGame JNI_OnLoad and retained for the runtime.

jni_env.semantics: The adapter owns the environment table and game-specific JNI dispatch.

activity.semantics: Rockstar initial setup and Activity-created callbacks form the adapter-specific Activity boundary.

android_runtime_trace.semantics: The inventory proves static source order only; no Android runtime trace was captured or replayed.

execution.reason: The approved adapter has no complete focus, pause, save and shutdown sequence that satisfies a driven core profile.

graphics_surface_order.semantics: The real GL context is created before implOnSurfaceCreated and implOnSurfaceChanged.

proven_phase_projection.semantics: libGame is relocated, resolved, finalized and its complete constructor array has returned.
Adapter VM and environment are stable and JNI_OnLoad has returned; its version is not validated by the source adapter.
Rockstar initial setup and Activity-created callbacks have completed.
The adapter starts real host graphics acquisition for the first surface generation.
The host GL context is current before guest surface callbacks.
implOnSurfaceCreated has returned.
implOnSurfaceChanged has received the real dimensions.
The Rockstar resume callback has returned.
The adapter synchronously owns the implOnDrawFrame loop and its host input pump.

gaps.semantics: The approved source returns from the draw lifecycle and uses process-lifetime termination without a complete proven close sequence; these phases must not be synthesized.

terminal_contract.semantics: The observed adapter action cannot be promoted until focus, pause and save boundaries are proven.

profiles.rollback_policy: No rollback callback is declared because the approved source does not prove a separate compensating path.

java_vm.semantics: A stable adapter VM is installed before JNI_OnLoad because f2f retains it.

jni_env.semantics: The adapter owns the environment table and fox/f2f object dispatch.

activity.semantics: A stable game context token exists, but the approved source has no distinct Activity-create boundary.

android_runtime_trace.semantics: The inventory proves static source order only; no Android runtime trace was captured or replayed.

execution.reason: The source-proven GL_READY to ENTRY to OBJECTS_READY to SURFACE_UP projection requires the narrow pre-Surface-callback opt-in, but Activity, focus, input-close, pause, save and shutdown boundaries are not jointly proven.

graphics_surface_order.semantics: The source-proven order is GL_READY, ENTRY, OBJECTS_READY and then DrawEGLCreated/SURFACE_UP for the same cycle; this requires NXANDROID_PROFILE_ALLOW_ENTRY_BEFORE_SURFACE_CALLBACK and does not permit input or the run loop before Surface.

proven_phase_projection.semantics: The exact BuildID/layout patch has been validated and applied before finalize, cache flush and constructors.
The stable adapter VM has been passed to JNI_OnLoad; the returned version remains unvalidated.
The adapter begins EGL-shim window and context acquisition.
The EGL-shim context is current on the game thread.
Game paths, language and f2f object/context prerequisites are established before fox init.
fox init has received real dimensions and returned.
DrawEGLCreated has returned after the host context became current.
resumeEvent has cleared the engine pause state.
The synchronous loop preserves GameProcess-before-DrawFrame ordering.

gaps.semantics: The approved source has no complete Android close sequence and uses sync plus process-lifetime termination; missing phases must not be inferred from fox names.

terminal_contract.semantics: The observed action cannot become a core terminal step until pause and save are proven.

profiles.rollback_policy: No rollback callback is declared because the approved source does not prove a separate compensating path.

java_vm.semantics: The same stable adapter VM is retained across Unity and IL2CPP JNI_OnLoad.

jni_env.semantics: The adapter environment owns the real RegisterNatives registry consumed by Unity callbacks.

activity.semantics: Stable Unity thiz/context objects and initJni form the Activity contract boundary; the core creates none of them.

android_runtime_trace.semantics: The structurally valid profile is source-derived; no Android runtime trace or compatible real JavaVM was exercised.

execution.reason: The source proves focus, pause and preference flush but not distinct input close, surface teardown, native shutdown and terminal boundaries sufficient for a complete driven profile.

graphics_surface_order.semantics: The host EGL backend is created and made current before Unity nativeRecreateGfxState surface callbacks.

proven_phase_projection.semantics: Unity relocation, exact adapters, finalize and constructors have completed.
Unity JNI_OnLoad has returned using the stable adapter VM; its version is logged but not validated.
IL2CPP relocation, exact adapters, finalize and constructors have completed after Unity.
IL2CPP JNI_OnLoad has returned using the same VM; its version is logged but not validated.
Adapter-owned Unity Activity/context identities are stable before graphics callbacks; initJni remains adapter-specific.
The adapter requests the firmware-selected host graphics backend.
The selected EGL backend is current before guest surface recreation.
Unity nativeRecreateGfxState has accepted the adapter-owned surface.
The repeated recreation and native surface-changed event preserve the APK order.
Unity nativeResume has returned.
Unity nativeFocusChanged true has returned.
The registered nativeRender entry and Android loop-driver prerequisites are resolved.
HandlerThread and Choreographer ownership are established before render dispatch.
The adapter synchronously owns registered nativeRender and callback pumping until shutdown is requested.
Unity nativeFocusChanged false is dispatched first on close.
Unity nativePause follows focus loss.
Adapter-owned preferences are flushed after focus loss and pause and before terminal action.

gaps.semantics: No distinct input enable/disable contract, safe guest surface teardown, nativeDone completion or complete core terminal sequence is proven; none may be synthesized from callback-pump names.

terminal_contract.semantics: The observed process-lifetime action may become adapter-owned only after the missing input-close and terminal boundary is proved; the core itself never terminates.

profiles.rollback_policy: No rollback callback is declared; forward close phases are source-proven and must not be replayed as guessed compensation.

java_vm.semantics: The shared adapter VM is initialized before dependencies and retained for FMOD JNI_OnLoad.

jni_env.semantics: The Aspyr/SDL adapter environment and static export flow remain game-specific.

activity.semantics: nativeCreateMutex is the proven KOTOR.onCreate handshake and nativeOnResume precedes delegated SDL_main.

android_runtime_trace.semantics: The delegated source order is proven statically; lifecycle internal to SDL_main has no Android runtime trace in this evidence.

execution.reason: SDL_main is one synchronous blocking owner and must remain the final delegated callback; optional hidapi is selected before profile creation.

graphics_surface_order.semantics: SDL_main owns window, GL and surface ordering; the wrapper profile makes no claim about them.

proven_phase_projection.semantics: Lzma is initialized first and its exports are available to later modules.
Miniz is initialized after Lzma in leaves-first order.
Freetype is initialized before FMOD and the Aspyr modules.
FMOD constructors have completed before its JNI boundary.
FMOD JNI_OnLoad has returned a positive version using the shared adapter VM; no exact version is asserted.
The optional hidapi module is declared and initialized only in the selected with-hidapi profile variant.
The android_port provider module is initialized before libKOTOR.
libKOTOR is initialized last after every selected dependency.
The adapter performs the KOTOR.onCreate nativeCreateMutex handshake.
nativeOnResume clears the Aspyr pause flag before SDL_main.
The final synchronous adapter callback mounts available OBBs and enters SDL_main, which owns surface, GL, input, loop and terminal internally.

delegated_boundaries.semantics: These boundaries are intentionally opaque inside SDL_main; the wrapper must not fabricate them.

terminal_contract.semantics: RUNTIME_DELEGATED is final and synchronous; no wrapper TERMINAL phase is allowed after it.

profiles.rollback_policy: No rollback is invented across SDL_main; only failures before the delegated callback remain observable to the core.

java_vm.semantics: The full adapter bridge creates and retains the VM identity used by JNI 1.4.

jni_env.semantics: The adapter owns the complete environment table and keyed RegisterNatives registry.

activity.semantics: The exact Gameloft Activity and platform initialization sequence forms the Activity contract boundary.

android_runtime_trace.semantics: The lifecycle order is source-proven for the canonical adapter; no Android runtime trace was captured or replayed.

execution.reason: Focus, save and complete guest shutdown boundaries are not proven, so the observed process-lifetime close cannot be represented as a complete driven profile.

graphics_surface_order.semantics: Host video creates the real surface/context before the first resize and frame; GL_READY is projected after SURFACE_UP at that acquisition boundary.

proven_phase_projection.semantics: The explicit runtime gate has enabled guest code and the complete constructor array has returned after exact compatibility and finalize.
JNI_OnLoad has returned exactly JNI 1.4 and registered natives remain keyed by class, name and signature.
Activity, social, platform, device, billing, notification, data sharing and GameOptions initialization has completed in exact order.
GameOptions resume has returned before graphics acquisition.
The adapter begins Gameloft view, path and host video setup.
Host video has created the real display surface and context ownership.
The host GL context is ready after the surface acquisition boundary.
The engine has received state true and real landscape dimensions.
The first native step is dispatched only after the display and resize boundary.
The first frame has constructed engine-owned objects before controller listener startup.
Controller and input callbacks are enabled only after the first frame.
The adapter synchronously owns the native step and input pump loop.
GL and GameOptions pause callbacks run before input shutdown.
Adapter input is shut down after pause and before the exit dispatch.

gaps.semantics: The canonical adapter proves pause, input shutdown and exit dispatch, but no focus pair, save boundary or safe guest destroy; GL2JNILib_destroy is intentionally omitted.

terminal_contract.semantics: The process-lifetime destroy omission cannot become a core terminal step until a real save boundary and complete close contract are proven.

profiles.rollback_policy: No rollback callback is declared; the exact forward pause and input shutdown must never be duplicated by guessed compensation.
